agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom meeting no. 895 2027 5571
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak, or submit written comments is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

sub_agendas_items.title: Duty to Consult - Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
A slide deck presentation was delivered by Claire O’Donnell, Program Manager, Parks & Facilities Planning, Recreation, Cultural and Facilities Services Department; Agi Motz, Manager, Facilities Asset Management, Infrastructure and Water Services Department; Elizabeth Murphy, Program Manager, Transportation Engineering Services, Planning, Development and Building Services Department; and Kevin Wherry, Manager, Parks and Facilities Planning, Recreation, Cultural and Facilities Services Department; and Andrew J Smith, Program Manager, Infrastructure Renewal, Infrastructure and Water Services Department. 
Two individuals delegated at Committee. 
Members opened the floor for questions and answers of Staff. Claire O’Donnell, Program Manager, Parks & Facilities Planning, Recreation, Cultural and Facilities Services Department; Agi Motz, Manager, Facilities Asset Management, Infrastructure and Water Services Department; Elizabeth Murphy, Program Manager, Transportation Engineering Services, Planning, Development and Building Services Department; Kevin Wherry, Manager, Parks and Facilities Planning, Recreation, Cultural and Facilities Services Department; Andrew J Smith, Program Manager, Infrastructure Renewal, Infrastructure and Water Services Department, and Tyler Cox, Manager, Legislative Services, Office of the City Clerk were available to answer questions.
Members raised the following matters:
Following questions and answers of Staff, the Committee received the presentation.

motions.motion_text: That the Accessibility Advisory Committee receive the presentation and provide feedback asappropriate.
